name: Nemui
source: She insists she is not a part of the crew and most of the crew are happy to treat her that way too. She is a passenger who started off as a stowaway before reaching an unknown agreement with the previous captain for passage. Despite her rather lethargic nature, Nemui is a formidable fighter.
